gen-gf-underdog-gf-akatab: Underdog opens wide like a horseshoe, drawing each curve with a pen-like line that never swells or thins, while Akatab sits below with rounder, cupped letters. One shouts, the other murmurs.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-albert-sans: Albert Sans keeps its apertures open even at tiny sizes, with strokes that look the same in every direction. Underdog takes the top spot with a flat, commanding line, so the two divide the page into loud and quiet.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-antic: Expressive is the first word that comes to mind for Underdog, whose horseshoe-shaped c keeps one unchanging line throughout. Antic follows underneath with open, chalk-arc letter mouths that look drawn with a single nib, so the page moves from showy to steady.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-bpmf-huninn: Underdog draws every curve without any shift in weight, and its c opens wide like a horseshoe, giving the top line real presence. Bpmf Huninn sits beneath with a single-weight outline feel.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 feels approachable and businesslike, with wide channels leading into each counter and a tubelike thickness through every bend. And Underdog, with its horseshoe c and unshifting weight, does its best work large and brief.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri carries a moderate thick-thin ratio and a wide slot between the two ends of its c, giving words a mild shimmer. Underdog has no visible difference between upright and sideways strokes, so it works best set large and brief.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-electrolize: Underdog keeps a flat, unmodulated line and a horseshoe c. Electrolize, a plain sans with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, is modern and contemporary where Underdog is expressive and commanding.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-encode-sans-semi-cond: Loud but unfussy, Underdog holds one calm weight from word to word, its c opened wide like a horseshoe. Encode Sans Semi Condensed, a plain sans with an open counter on the s, keeps things modern and approachable underneath.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-gothic-a1: Pen-like and bold, Underdog holds a constant weight through every curve, its c gaping like a horseshoe. And Gothic A1, a plain sans with a splayed c terminal, keeps a longer read approachable and professional.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-gowun-dodum: Round, wide-mouthed and friendly, that's the feel here, with Underdog's horseshoe c leading above. But Gowun Dodum, a plain sans with a wide-mouthed a and smooth tubelike lines, is what makes the pair so clean.
